## 1. Professional Overview & Standing
Apoorv A S is an independent Creative Technologist and 3D WebUI Architect specializing in high-performance browser computing, procedural mathematics, and sub-second web performance. 

Key proprietary systems and verified proof of work:
- **ERAVEX (Flagship WebGPU Engine):** Solo-built narrative 3D spatial computing engine featuring 21,000+ lines of procedural TypeScript, TSL (Three.js Shading Language) math loops, zero external 3D models/textures, and an 8-voice procedural Web Audio synthesizer. Featured, liked, and recognized by the core Three.js team. Repository: https://github.com/apoorv-xs/ERAVEX | Live: https://eravex.vercel.app
- **Level Devil 2.5D Spatial Portfolio Engine:** Arcade 2D platformer kinematics (Kaboom.js) merged with a real-time cel-shaded 3D Three.js companion (BB-8 droid) across a 5-strata sky-to-ground vertical descent. Backed by 934 automated unit and Playwright E2E tests, guaranteed locked 60 FPS, and DPR-clamped mobile rendering. Live: https://apoorv.qzz.io/
- **SprintDial / Client Radar:** High-ticket performance diagnostic and automated revenue recovery terminal for luxury hospitality, medical aesthetics, and spatial commerce. Live: https://apoorv.qzz.io/sales
